_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja SymSinthia (62 terminy, ~19 mikroscen) - wspolny pokoj z pryczami Symmetry i Sinthii (para). Zawiera oddzielne lozka obu postaci, tajemnicze zdjecie podwodne, oraz drobne szczegoly ich osobowosci (rysunki Sinthii, energia Sym).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_BG/Section.en: It's Sym and Sinthia's bunk room.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_BG/Section.pl: To pokój z pryczami Sym i Sinthii.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Familyphoto.en:
It's been hung from the pipe,
so you can see it from the bed.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Familyphoto.pl:
Powieszono to na rurze,
żeby było widać z łóżka.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Familyphoto.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Underwater.en: Well, I guess we can start by asking Sym and Sinthia about it.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Underwater.pl: Cóż, chyba możemy zacząć od zapytania o to Sym i Sinthii.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_Underwater.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bird/Sectio.en: The movement of the submarine makes it look like it's blowing in the wind...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bird/Sectio.pl: Ruch łodzi podwodnej sprawia, że wygląda, jakby powiewał na wietrze...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bird/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_boardgame/S.en:
Oh cool, a board game.
Wanna play?
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_boardgame/S.pl:
O, super, gra planszowa.
Chcesz zagrać?
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_boardgame/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_boardgame/S.en: ...you don't normally let that stop you.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_boardgame/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bookpile/Se.en:
Old books...
Mostly fairy tales for young children.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bookpile/Se.pl:
Stare książki...
Głównie bajki dla małych dzieci.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bookpile/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bookpile/Se.en: They've been stacked up into a little tower.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_bookpile/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_craftbox/Se.en: A little wooden box with art supplies inside.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_craftbox/Se.pl: Małe drewniane pudełko z przyborami plastycznymi w środku.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_craftbox/Se.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_drawings/Se.en:
A few drawings.
A mouse, a girl, a leaf-
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_drawings/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.en: Look at that little wooden house!
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.pl: Spójrz na ten mały drewniany domek!
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.en: Looks like it'd be a nice place to live.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.pl: Wygląda na miłe miejsce do mieszkania.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_house1/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_ladder/Sect.en: Imagine having to climb a ladder every time you want to go to bed...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_ladder/Sect.pl: Wyobraź sobie, że musisz wspinać się po drabinie za każdym razem, gdy chcesz iść do łóżka...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_ladder/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.en: My hair is perfect and does [h]not[/h] need fixing.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.pl: Moje włosy są idealne i [h]nie[/h] potrzebują poprawek.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.en: Sally - you can use it to fix your hair.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.pl: Sally - możesz go użyć, żeby poprawić swoje włosy.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_mirror/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.en:
Instant photos.
The kind you have to shake.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.pl:
Zdjęcia natychmiastowe.
Takie, które trzeba potrząsać.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.en:
That's a myth, actually - you shouldn't shake them.
It damages them.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.pl:
To właściwie mit - nie powinno się nimi potrząsać.
To je niszczy.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.en:
Well.
That's [h]my[/h] life turned upside down.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.pl:
Cóż.
To [h]moje[/h] życie wywrócone do góry nogami.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_polaroids/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_sinthiabed1.en: How can you tell it's hers?
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_sinthiabed1.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.en: It's a window. It must be a light, too, since we're underwater...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.pl: To okno. Musi być też lampą, skoro jesteśmy pod wodą...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.en: They've taped yellow paper to it.
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.en: I think they want it to look like the sun...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.pl: Myślę, że chcą, żeby wyglądało jak słońce...
Examine/Exam_Area_SymSinthia_window/Sect.speaker: Sally
